GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 3, 2026
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Larry Conkings, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Robert Meliere, Vice Chair  Kevin Fitzgerald, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Lilia.Romero@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55981  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, March 26, 2026, and Thursday, June 4, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

2.  26-55982  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

3.  26-55983  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and the Long Beach Golf Festival.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

4.  26-55985  Recommendation to endorse the proposed Food and Beverage pricing updates
  and recommend the Director approve the changes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

5.  26-55986  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
